description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Hope of Ghirapur from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Hope of Ghirapur, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Hope of Ghirapur by sacrificing it.
Repeat.
